basic_details.job_title: MNLU Mumbai Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 4 Hostel Caretaker cum Driver, Hostel Caretaker Posts
basic_details.short_information: Maharashtra National Law University Mumbai is hiring for 4 hostel posts on a one-year contract: 2 Hostel Caretaker (Female) posts and 2 Hostel Caretaker-cum-Driver (Male) posts. Candidates who have passed 10+2 and are 25 to 45 years old can apply. Both posts pay a consolidated salary of Rs. 25,000/-. The deadline for the online application is 15 November 2026 at 23.59 hrs, and you must also send a printed copy to the University in Powai, Mumbai.

application_fee.details: The fee is paid online and cannot be refunded. Keep the payment receipt (UTR no.) because it goes with your printed application.

age_limit.details: Reserved category candidates get up to five (05) years of relaxation in the upper age limit. To claim it, they must produce a valid caste or category certificate issued by the competent authority, and the relaxation follows the applicable government rules. In exceptional cases, the University may also relax age, qualification or experience for a candidate it finds particularly suitable. This is at its sole discretion. | See the official notification for the full eligibility conditions for each post.

how_to_apply: Download and fill in the application form from the University website, www.mnlumumbai.edu.in. It is available from 30 October 2026.
Pay the application fee online and note the UTR number.
Fill in your details on the Google link given at the end of the notice and print out the completed form.
Email a scanned copy of the application form and scans of the required documents to [email protected] by 15 November 2026 (23.59 hrs).
Stick a passport-size photo on the printed application.

Put the printout, the payment receipt, the Google form printout and self-attested copies of your documents in a sealed envelope. Write "Application for the post of (name of the post)" on the envelope.

Deliver it in person or send it by post to: Registrar, Maharashtra National Law University Mumbai, 2nd Floor, CETTM MTNL Building, Technology Street, Hiranandani Gardens, Powai, Mumbai- 400076 (Maharashtra). Tel. no. 022- 25703188.

The University only accepts the printout of the prescribed online form. A bio-data, a CV or any other offline application will not be considered. Applications that arrive late, are incomplete, have no documents attached or do not come through the proper channel will be rejected without any communication. The University is not responsible if an application is lost or delayed.
Educational qualification documents: certificates, statements of marks (photocopies of both sides) and any other relevant certificates
Experience certificate(s) issued by the competent authority
Birth or SSC certificate, or another government document, as proof of date of birth
If you have changed your name: a copy of the Government Gazette or another appropriate certificate
Caste or category certificate, if you are claiming age relaxation
Four-wheeler Light Vehicle Driving Licence (Hostel Caretaker-cum-Driver)
Giving false information leads to disqualification at any stage, even after appointment. Canvassing, directly or indirectly, also leads to disqualification.

content_sections.heading: About MNLU Mumbai
content_sections.text: Maharashtra National Law University Mumbai was set up on 27th June 2014 by the Government of Maharashtra under Act VI of 2014. It is on the 2nd Floor of the MTNL-CETTM Building, Technology Street, Hiranandani Gardens, Powai, Mumbai - 400 076. These posts are for the University's hostel.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is by interview. Shortlisted candidates receive call letters. At the interview you must bring your original documents for verification, plus two sets of photocopies of all of them. The Selection Committee may relax or change the eligibility criteria or selection requirements for suitable candidates, subject to the rules and the Competent Authority's approval.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is purely temporary, contractual and ad-hoc. It gives no right to a regular appointment, continuation, permanency or absorption in the University. The contract runs for one year. Any extension depends on satisfactory performance, the University's continuing needs and the prior written approval of the Competent Authority. Extensions are never automatic. Both posts are full-time residential service. The rules and regulations of the University and the Government, and the directives of the Government of Maharashtra, apply to these posts. The University may fill or not fill any post, or withdraw any post, without giving a reason.

faq.question: Q1. Can men apply for the Hostel Caretaker post?
faq.answer: No. The Hostel Caretaker post is for women only. Men can apply for the Hostel Caretaker-cum-Driver (Male) post, which also has 2 vacancies.

faq.question: Q2. Do I need a driving licence?
faq.answer: Only for the Hostel Caretaker-cum-Driver (Male) post, which requires a four-wheeler Light Vehicle Driving Licence.

faq.question: Q3. Is experience compulsory?
faq.answer: For the Caretaker-cum-Driver post, yes: one year of experience in a similar field is essential, with a certificate as proof. For the female Caretaker post, one year of experience is listed under Desirable.

faq.question: Q4. Do I have to live on campus?
faq.answer: Yes. Both posts are described as "Full Time (Residential Service)".

faq.question: Q5. What is the age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is relaxed by up to five years if you produce a valid caste or category certificate from the competent authority.

faq.question: Q6. Where do I send the printed application?
faq.answer: To the Registrar, Maharashtra National Law University Mumbai, 2nd Floor, CETTM MTNL Building, Technology Street, Hiranandani Gardens, Powai, Mumbai-400076. You can post it or hand it in.

faq.question: Q7. Can this contract become a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The notice says the appointment gives no claim to regularisation, permanency or absorption. It may be extended only with written approval from the Competent Authority.

faq.question: Q8. What should I bring to the interview?
faq.answer: Your original documents for verification and two sets of photocopies of all of them.

faq.question: Q9. Is the Google form compulsory?
faq.answer: Yes. You must fill in your details on the Google link given in the notice and submit its printout with your application form.
